digest.component_or_area: autodeploy gate and review-bot container lifecycle
propositions: autodeploy recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing reviews mid-execution when main advances during landing bursts
the reconciler's retry path is unprotected by the app's shutdown queue drain, so killed reviews cannot self-heal when the retry is also killed by the next deploy
the gate live-locks when deploy intervals are shorter than review completion time, with no VOTER_ERROR emitted and all health signals remaining green
deferral of deploys while reviews are in-flight prevents recreation during bursts, with deferred deploys coalescing into a single deployment at the newest tip
observability is added via in_flight counter on /health endpoint and new AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT alarm to detect the previously-invisible live-lock condition
